paraphrase: I praise the praiseworthy Vāsudeva, ever blissful and stainless, the lord of Indirā, who grants boons even to the first of those who grant boons.

original.text: vande vandyaṃ sadānandaṃ vāsudevaṃ nirañjanam | indirāpatim ādyādivaradeśavarapradam ||1||
